trial_court: Family Court No. 1, Jaipur City, Jaipur (Divorce Petition No. 450/2010)
case_name: Smt Monalika Mathur vs Family Court No-1 Jaipur City

parties.respondent_defendant: Family Court, No. 1, Jaipur City, Jaipur & Another

facts_of_case: The applicant has instituted two petitions under the Hindu Marriage Act against Respondent No. 2; a divorce petition has been instituted by Respondent No. 2 at Jaipur.

legal_principles.principle: Since there is no dispute between the parties, it will be appropriate that present case, relating to matrimonial dispute, pending at Jaipur between the parties
legal_principles.held: Since there is no dispute between the parties that two cases, first under Section 9 and another under Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act, are pending between the parties in the Family Court at Ajmer, therefore, it will be appropriate that present case, relating to matrimonial dispute, pending at Jaipur between the parties

legal_principles.principle: It will be appropriate that all the cases may be consolidated and dispose off simultaneously
legal_principles.held: He submitted that since Respondent No. 2 is already attending two cases at Ajmer, therefore, it will be appropriate that the case pending in Family Court No. 1, Jaipur City, Jaipur may also be transferred to Family Court at Ajmer, so all the cases may be consolidated and dispose off simultaneously

outcome.final_order: Divorce Petition No. 450/2010 is transferred to Family Court at Ajmer.

use_for_drafting: requesting judicial transfer of a case
consolidating multiple cases in a single court
